name: pan-earthquake-emsr934
notes:
This dataset contains Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping products for activation EMSR934. On 09 October at 17:56 UTC (12:56 Local Time) Panama was struck by a 7.7M earthquake. The epicentre was 12 km west-southwest of Pitaloza Arriba, Panama (inland). Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide earthquake damage assessment emergency mapping. GDACS ID: EQ1570339.

**Citation:** Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© 2026 European Union), EMSR934

**Product types present in this dataset's resources:**  
**GRA (Grading)**: assesses damage to individual features (eg. buildings, infrastructure).

Where a GeoPackage download is available for an Area of Interest/round, it already contains every layer with its official Copernicus styling and colours - prefer it in GIS software over the zipped shapefile download.
